mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent GDP contraction.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE spike does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase does not correlate with subsequent GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the CPIAUCSL YoY is above 2%, the combination signals an accommodative monetary policy despite inflationary pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of low FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent equity market performance.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% coupled with an increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of low UNRATE and high PAYEMS does not correlate with subsequent equity market performance.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% YoY signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of instances with HOUST increase > 10% YoY, or HOUST increase does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a decrease in Real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% YoY signals a contractionary impact on economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 decrease does not correlate with subsequent economic contraction.
